tagline: AI code review bots, review agents, security reviewers and the tooling that puts them in a pull request.
scope: It is about AI reviewing code changes, not a general coding assistant or linter.
heroAlt: Animated isometric scene: a reviewer bot slides down a rail beside a tall diff panel, scanning each added and removed line with a beam, comment cards slide out at flagged lines while three checks pass in turn, then an approval stamp lands on the panel.
